title: Seasuite Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Seasuite is a 1.00 bedroom, 1.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 12 EAST RUSKIN STREET*Please be advised that neighboring properties may currently be undergoing construction or renovation during your stay. As a result, intermittent noise or construction-related activity may occur at certain times throughout the day. This work is managed by third parties outside of our control, and we appreciate your understanding while enjoying the property. For additional questions or concerns regarding nearby construction activity, please contact Homeowner’s Collection at 1-855-411-1557.Welcome to Seasuite | A Steps-From-the-Sand Seaside EscapeWelcome to Seasuite, a modern guest cottage located directly across from the beach in Seaside, Florida, just 59 steps (59 feet) to the private beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion. This prime location places you only 450 feet—a two-minute walk—from downtown Seaside and the Seaside Amphitheater, with more than 35 shops and restaurants easily accessible right from your front door. Perfect for couples or small families, Seasuite offers a peaceful coastal retreat with unbeatable walkability. It may be rented on its own or together with the main home, Slow Mocean, for expanded accommodations.Private Guest Cottage with Thoughtful DesignAccess Seasuite via a sandy footpath that leads to your private guest cottage entrance. This newer construction home has been thoughtfully designed with modern finishes and coastal charm throughout. On the first floor, guests will find a comfortable queen bedroom complete with a closet and a mounted flat-screen TV. Just steps away is a full bathroom featuring a marble single vanity and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower, creating a spa-like feel for your stay.Modern Living Space & Kitchenette UpstairsThe second floor opens to a bright and inviting living space paired with a stylish kitchenette showcasing glass tile inlaid countertops. The kitchenette includes a bar sink, compact microwave, Bosch mini dishwasher, Keurig and drip coffee maker, toaster, and two refrigerator drawers (note: there is no freezer, stovetop, or oven). The adjacent living area features designer furnishings, a queen sleeper sofa, and a smart TV—ideal for relaxing after a day at the beach.Private Porch with Gulf BreezesDouble doors from the living room lead to a furnished open-air porch overlooking a shaded yard and scenic views along 30A. Sip your morning coffee or unwind in the evening while enjoying the sound of waves just steps away—an unmistakable Seaside experience.Added Conveniences for a Perfect StayAdditional amenities include a stackable washer and dryer and a private outdoor shower located just outside the front entrance—perfect for rinsing off after a beach day. With its exceptional location, thoughtful design, and effortless access to the beach and town center, Seasuite is an ideal coastal getaway for guests seeking comfort, privacy, and the magic of Seaside, Florida—all just steps from the Gulf.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES480 square feetLocated directly across from the beach on 30ASeaside Private Residential Beach at East Ruskin Pavilion1-minute walk, 59 feet to beach access at East Ruskin PavilionKitchenette note: Compact refrigerator with two-drawer fridge; no freezerPeacock Alley Linens – Fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeResort-style amenities access: 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service with starter amenities providedParking policy: Only 1 parking pass per one-bedroom cottage. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002086
